notes.title: Patch 2.0 is Live - Check Out What's New
notes.notes:
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2][list][*][p]Camera movement both in and outside of combat has been refined for a more immersive and responsive experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Most of the combat animations have been replaced with new, more fluid and responsive versions to improve the overall feel of the action.[/p][/*][*][p]Various movement animations have also been reworked, making transitions between states feel more natural.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation transitions are now smoother across the board, reducing jarring or abrupt visual changes during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Crouch functionality has been removed, as it had no measurable impact on gameplay or mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Bow special attacks have been updated and now deal proper damage including explosive arrows, which now detonate with expected results.[/p][/*][*][p]The boss interaction system has been revamped to offer more meaningful and consistent encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new types of vendors have been introduced, offering a wider range of services and items to explore.[/p][/*][*][p]Several new special attacks have been added, each designed to enrich combat diversity and strategy.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy AI has been significantly improved, making engagements more challenging and varied.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss AI has also been upgraded to introduce more complex behaviors and reactive patterns. (Still WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]A wide selection of new armor sets and weapons has been introduced, expanding build options and visual customization.[/p][/*][*][p]The main quest line has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue system has been enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo system has been refined for better responsiveness and feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]A new tutorial system has been added to help new players ease into the core mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy spawn system has been improved to provide better pacing, better performance and level scaling throughout gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]VISUALS[/h2][list][*][p][b]Lighting Overhauls:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full lighting overhauls have been completed in [b]Topkapi Palace, Caravanserai, Hippodrome, Crypt [/b]and[b] Galata Square[/b] significantly enhancing mood, clarity, and realism.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Models & Textures:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New clothing variants have been introduced, enriching the visual diversity of characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Blood pool visuals, hair card quality, character model polish, and overall environmental textures have been upgraded for greater immersion.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Physics & Effects:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Realistic cloth physics have been implemented for armors and outfits, adding dynamic movement. (Still WIP)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE[/h2][list][*][p]Lighting systems have been optimized to reduce GPU load.[/p][/*][*][p]Water systems have been optimized to reduce GPU load.[/p][/*][*][p]Skin cache has been streamlined to reduce performance overhead.[/p][/*][*][p]The entire texture library has undergone optimization to reduce memory usage and loading times.[/p][/*][*][p]All materials have been reworked and optimized for better in-game performance and less visual glitches.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]MISSIONS[/h2][list][*][p][b]“Find Destan” Quest:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The secret door logic has been reworked to improve clarity and discovery pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest text has been refined for better narrative tone and guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]Sultan’s dialogue has been revised.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BALANCE[/h2][list][*][p]The in-game economy has been rebalanced to improve pacing, challenge, and item relevance.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy statistics have been adjusted for a more consistent difficulty curve across different zones.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss statistics have been reviewed to ensure each boss fight feels unique and appropriately challenging.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot drop rates have been fine-tuned for better progression and reward satisfaction.[/p][/*][*][p]The ability system has been balanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Archers have been reworked and will no longer one-shot players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]The death screen has been redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p]The active quest widget is redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p]The level cleared widget has been reworked for a more satisfying progression acknowledgment.[/p][/*][*][p]A new skill tree interface has been introduced. (Still WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]Some item icons in the inventory have been updated for better visual distinction.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue interactions now support click-to-advance functionality for smoother reading flow.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]AUDIO[/h2][list][*][p]Enemies now produce unique sound effects when damaged, enhancing combat audio feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]New footstep sounds have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The main character has received additional sound effects to reinforce actions.[/p][/*][*][p]UI now features improved auditory feedback, making navigation and interaction feel more responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]LEVELS[/h2][p][b]Topkapi:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Palace is replaced with new, completely overhauled version.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mirror interaction now has proper collision detection and no longer works through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Cellar dungeon doors now feature improved collision for smoother navigation.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Caravanserai:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected mesh collision issues to prevent player snagging or clipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss area has been visually and mechanically updated for a more dramatic showdown.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hippodrome:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mesh collisions have been corrected to improve movement and line-of-sight consistency.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Galata Square & Tower:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Boss area has been redesigned.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]Players no longer get stuck in sprint mode after interacting with NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes related to bow-rolling lock and ranged executions.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipping two-handed weapons no longer causes item deletion from inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Nudity filter now applies correctly to companions upon reloading a saved game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rendering issues with various materials not displaying properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Socket placements on weapons have been corrected to prevent awkward grip positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Hair clipping issues have been addressed on multiple models.[/p][/*][*][p]Dragging consumables to portraits no longer results in duplicated items.[/p][/*][*][p]Character presets and quest progress now reset properly when starting a new game.[/p][/*][*][p]Companion XP is now loaded correctly when resuming from saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Attribute points now apply as intended when allocated.[/p][/*][*][p]UV issues on both weapons and armors have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental UV errors have been fixed for more seamless visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Health, Stamina, and Mana bars now update accurately and in real-time.[/p][/*][*][p]Empty inventory/vendor slots are now truly non-interactable.[/p][/*][/list][p]And hundreds of bug fixes & new features we couldn't be able to list here 😎[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🙏 [b]Thank you for your continued support, feedback, and passion![/b]
We’re working hard to make the world richer, smoother, and more rewarding.
[b]Please enjoy this update and keep sharing your thoughts with us![/b][/p]

notes.notes: [h2]SURVEY[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new survey to the main menu, please check that out and help us shape the Concubine.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted camera distance to player inside combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed idle animation for dual wield state.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled crouch state as it doesn't have any impact on gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed camera character preset appears on new game start.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where new game start does not reset quest progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where archers could kill the player with only one arrow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where camera could stuck in combat mode even after the combat ends in some instances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where equipping two-handed weapons could result game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attribute points does not work.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where clicking the dialogue text does not advance the onto the same character's portrait could result in doubling of item quantity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dragging an equipped item from the equipment slot onto the same character's portrait on the inventory screen would result in the item being removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dragging an item from companion inventory onto a shop item causes an unintended trade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sold items doesn't disappear if they are equipped when the trade happens.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support and feedback. Stay tuned and keep sharing your feedback with us. Please Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Live - Check Out What's New
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Gameplay[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced camera movement logic in combat.
[*]    Added a logic that moves the camera to a state where players can follow what's happening in the combat more easily.
[*]    Added a logic that dynamically changes camera position, rotation and field of view acccording to current combat state.
[*] Added a warning when player tries to use the bow without equipping a quiver.
[*] Improved camera movement logic outside of combat.
[*] Improved Enemy AI to be more responsive and agressive.
[*] Improved Enemy AI strafing and path finding logic.
[/list]

[b][h1]Balance[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled mana drains on Special Attacks.
[*] Balanced loot drops from enemies according to level in Caravanserai, Hippodrome, Crypt and Galata Square.
[*] Balanced loot drops from Bosses.
[*] Balanced enemy wave size.
[/list]

[b][h1]Visuals[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved more than 70 materials to make their shading more physically accurate, and also high quality.
[*] Added a logic that occludes nearby objects when gets between player character and camera.
[/list]

[b][h1]UI[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Changed death screen to fit rest of the ui.
[/list]

[b][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new short dialogue to Alchemist.
[*] Added new weapons to Weaponsmith.
[*] Added new armors to Armorsmith.
[*] Added different colored variations of starter armor.
[*] Added different colored variations of Midnight Siren armor.
[*] Removed 2 armors with fitting problems from Armorsmith to be fixed on a later update.
[*] Removed outliner from the uninteractable door in Topkapi.
[*] Changed the start count of trade slider in the vendor menu from maximum to 1.
[*] Minor performance improvements to enemy ai.
[*] Improved obstacle avoidance logic for enemies.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
[h3]    Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where enemies can stuck on stairs in Hippodrome.
[*]     Fixed an issue where player can go outside of the map in Hippodrome.
[*]     Fixed an issue where players can get out of the map if place too many objects in decoration mode on top of each other and climb onto them.
[*]     Fixed an issue where player can stuck in a dialogue with Destan.
[*]     Fixed an issue where dual-wielded weapons spawn under the character.
[*]     Fixed an issue where player can not use duel-wielded weapons.
[*]     Fixed an issue where shields stays at a wrong spot when sheated.
[*]     Fixed an issue where player gets healed when switching armors.
[*]     Fixed an issue where an enemy's death prevents other enemies to attack in some instances.
[*]     Fixed an issue where enemies could strafe constantly without attacking.
[*]     Fixed an issue where an enemy could prevent others from attacking.
[*]     Fixed an issue where an enemy far from the player could prevent closer enemies to attack.
[*]     Fixed an issue where enemies could stand still after spawn.
[*]     Fixed an issue where an enemy could prevent the boss from attacking to player.
[*]     Fixed an issue where character can rotate too slow after landingg in some instances.
[*]     Fixed an issue where changing armors can increase vitality after loading into the game.
[*]     Fixed the issue where companions were often not attacking.
[*]     Fixed an issue with companion desired attack range.
[*]     Fixed an issue with companion target selection.
[*]     Fixed an issue where the game could not save the progress and cause player to spawn in the Topkapi whenever they die.
[/list]
[h3]    Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where low-health visual effects doesn't disappear when heal.
[*]     Fixed an issue where low health indicator on screen might not disappear when level up.
[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedback. Stay tuned and keep sharing your feedback with us. Please Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0 is Live - Check Out What's New
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Gameplay[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Added dual-wield function for one handed weapons.
[*] Enabled item outliners for interactable items in [i]Caravanserai[/i].
[*] Increased enemy count in [i]Galata Square[/i].
[*] Added [i]Quiver[/i] to weaponsmith. You can now use bows if you equip a quiver with a bow.
[*] Fixed an issue where fists does not work before on some instances.
[*] Fixed an issue where player character can turn around slower then normal on some instances.
[/list]

[b][h1]Balance[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted vendor item prices.
[*] Adjusted loot drop values for [i]Caravanserai[/i] enemies.
[/list]

[b][h1]Audio[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where audio sliders in the settings does not work.
[/list]

[b][h1]Visuals[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where blood decals might disappear during animations when an enemy is killed.
[*] Disabled background blur when purchasing items from vendors. It is now possible to see currently owned gold and gem amount during item amount selection.
[*] Scaled down damage type & number indicators that were taking too much screen space before.
[*] Improved carpet materials to make it's shading more physically accurate.
[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedback. Stay tuned and keep sharing your feedback with us. Please Enjoy!
